answer: Because the violet calculation reruns each epoch, the ledge weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the vine settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 63% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 197 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 15 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
